name: manual_4a87fb
claim: Before writing a new module, search the sibling repositories for existing logic and reuse and upgrade it. The first spend guard in orama duplicated what Perpetua-Tools already had: CostGuard (atomic reserve, commit, rollback, a budget file), a provider policy format with official source urls (the BigModel free-first policy), and a frugality router. Perpetua-Tools is the runtime and state authority and orama is stateless, so shared state logic belongs in Perpetua-Tools and orama consumes it through a thin adapter that fails closed. Search order: code-review-graph, gbrain, then targeted grep for budget, spend, cost, policy and guard in both repositories, before the first line of new code.
conditions: reuse existing logic search sibling repositories shared guard state authority adapter duplicate

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: the operator asked for the guard to be held in common and to reuse existing logic; a grep of both repositories found cost_guard.py, dispatch_guard.py, frugality_router.py, bigmodel-free-first-policy.json and model-governance.yml that the first version ignored; it was replaced before being pushed.
